title: CNA Insider | Asia’s Stuck Generation
description: Documentary exploring how young graduates cope with low pay and high costs.
longDescription: A documentary examining how Taiwan's young university graduates navigate stagnant wages and rising living costs. The film follows everyday workers as they share coping strategies and question the promise of higher education.
heading: Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: Stuck With Low Pay, How Taiwan's Young Graduates Cope With High Costs | Asia's Stuck Generation.
videos.description: A multi-character documentary on Taiwanese graduates juggling long commutes, multiple jobs, and shrinking savings as low wages and high living costs undercut the promise of higher education.

title: CNA | Dear Singapore
description: Documentary featuring singer Jasmine Sokko on chasing music dreams.
longDescription: A short documentary profiling Singaporean electronic-pop artist Jasmine Sokko and her journey chasing music dreams. Part of the 'Dear Singapore' series, the film explores the personal sacrifices and creative vision behind her rise.
heading: Field Producer | Local Fixer

videos.title: Singer Jasmine Sokko On Chasing Her Music Dreams: Every Dream Is Equally Worthy | Dear Singapore
videos.description: An intimate profile of Jasmine Sokko as she reflects on choosing music over stability, turning an unconventional career into a story about risk, identity, and what creative ambition costs in Singapore.

title: 8World | Fun转时光
description: Documentary series exploring Singapore's heritage and nostalgic locations.
longDescription: A five-part Mandarin-language documentary series revisiting Singapore's heritage districts and the memories they hold. Each episode uncovers the history of an iconic location — from Katong's beauty pageants to Fort Canning's playgrounds and the legendary satay club.
heading: Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: Fun转时光 | 彻夜卷发、鱼尾狮穿上身 80年代美姐难当! - Katong
videos.description: A nostalgic return to Katong through the lens of old-school glamour, pageant culture, and the beauty rituals that shaped a generation of Singaporean women.

videos.title: Fun转时光 | 旧时的余东璇街 是戏院美食街 - Wayang Street
videos.description: This episode retraces Wayang Street when it was packed with cinemas, crowds, and street food, mapping how entertainment once animated the neighborhood after dark.

videos.title: Fun转时光 | 皇家山六七十年代超好玩 探索昔日回忆的三宝! - Fort Canning
videos.description: Fort Canning becomes a memory map of play, freedom, and family outings, revisiting the attractions that made the hill a favorite weekend destination in the 1960s and 1970s.

videos.title: Fun转时光 | "五丛树脚"吃沙爹 老一辈独有的吃法 - Satay Club
videos.description: A food-memory episode about the old Satay Club, where smoky grills, shared tables, and improvised rituals turned a meal into a distinctly Singaporean night out.

videos.title: Fun转时光 | 桥北路消失的光影记忆：光华大戏院 - Jubilee Theatre
videos.description: The series closes at Jubilee Theatre, recovering the vanished movie-going culture of North Bridge Road and the emotional pull these lost venues still hold.

title: 8world | 看见主播
description: 8world health series on midlife nutrition, mental health, menopause, and chronic disease risk in Singapore.
longDescription:
A four-part 8world series fronted by anchor Wang Zheng that turns midlife health concerns into practical, accessible stories. Across the episodes, the reporting looks at how busy Singaporeans in their 40s and 50s eat when they rely on hawker food, how to spot mental-health warning signs that get dismissed as everyday stress, why hypertension and high cholesterol often stay hidden until serious harm is done, and how menopause can reshape the body in ways many women only recognise once the changes have taken hold.

Jinee co-directed and shot the series in Singapore.
heading: Co-Director | Videographer

videos.title: 【看见主播 | 王征】40+这么吃，才不会发福？外食族必看
description: This episode focuses on the everyday diet traps facing midlife Singaporeans who depend on hawker meals and fast convenience.
It turns nutrition advice into practical food choices viewers can use without abandoning the routines of working life.

videos.title: 【看见主播 | 王征】40岁后最危险的不是压力
videos.description: An episode about the warning signs that stress, burnout, and mental-health struggles are no longer manageable with the usual 'just push through' mindset.

videos.title: 【看见主播 | 王征】40岁后你以为的健康，可能是错觉
videos.description: The reporting looks at how hidden risks such as high blood pressure and cholesterol stay invisible until a serious health scare forces action.

videos.title: 【看见主播 | 王征】女性40+，身体正在发生什么变化？
description: Wang Zheng guides viewers through a rethinking of menopause, explaining why women 45+ may notice waist gain and other body changes even when they are not eating more.
The episode frames menopause as a subtle but long-lasting transition, with doctors describing it less as decline than as a kind of 'phoenix rising'.

title: 8world | 前线追踪
description: 8world Frontline report on social media addiction, school phone rules, and teen screen habits in Singapore.
longDescription:
This Frontline report examines what compulsive social-media use looks like for young people in Singapore, following a subject who deletes every app after years of overuse. The story connects personal dependency with a wider policy shift as schools tighten phone rules and families ask whether restrictions can change behaviour once the habit is already formed.

Jinee shot the episode for 8world.
heading: Videographer

videos.title: 前线追踪 | 深陷社媒四年 他删光所有应用
description: This Frontline report follows a 20-year-old who deletes every social-media app after four years of compulsive use, showing how endless scrolling and fear of missing out can take over daily life.

Part of 8world's long-running current-affairs series 前线追踪, the episode widens the story into Singapore's tighter school phone rules and the larger question of whether restrictions alone can change behavior.

title: CNA Insider | Our Blind Kitchen
description: Three-part CNA Insider documentary on visually impaired chefs building an inclusive cafe in Singapore.
longDescription:
This three-part documentary follows visually impaired chefs as they work toward opening an inclusive cafe in Singapore. The series tracks the pressure behind the idea as the team navigates kitchen safety, staffing setbacks, and the wider question of what meaningful employment and independence can look like for people with partial sight.

Jinee researched, produced, directed, and shot the series.
heading: Researcher | Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: Episode 1: We're Chefs, We're Partly Blind & We're Opening A Cafe
videos.description: The opener follows visually impaired cooks and their founder as they retrofit Kunyah Cafe, testing whether an inclusive kitchen can create real career paths without softening the pressure of service.

videos.title: Episode 2: A Chef Makes A Shock Exit, But Why?
videos.description: This middle chapter turns on a team rupture weeks before launch, showing how clashing working styles and startup pressure can threaten an inclusion-focused idea from the inside.

videos.title: Episode 3: I Hire A Chef With Cerebral Palsy, 3 Days Before Opening
videos.description: The finale races through a last-minute hire, urgent training, and opening-day nerves, ending the series on whether the cafe can prove disabled staff belong at the center of a commercial kitchen.

title: CNA Insider | On The Red Dot
description: CNA Insider On The Red Dot documentary on comedian Suhaimi Yusof and his son navigating fame, family and a life-changing stroke.
longDescription:
This On The Red Dot documentary follows actor-comedian Suhaimi Yusof and his youngest son Sufi as they spend rare one-on-one time together, opening up about fame, family, and the impact of a life-changing stroke. The film stays close to their honest conversations about expectation, vulnerability, and the transition into adulthood, showing how long-overdue talks can strengthen the bonds that matter most.

Jinee produced and directed the piece in Singapore.
heading: Producer | Director

videos.title: "There's A Lot Of Expectation": Growing Up As Comedian Suhaimi Yusof's Son | On The Red Dot
videos.description: An intimate father-son portrait in which comedian Suhaimi Yusof and his son Sufi confront fame, expectation, and the aftermath of a stroke, using heartfelt conversations to redefine how they understand each other.

portfolioCard.cardTitle: CNA Insider | On The Red Dot

title: 8World | 七天我可以 7 Days, I Can Do It
description: 8world challenge series following chef Eric Teo as he learns archery and attempts a 300-point test in seven days.
longDescription:
This two-part 8world challenge follows chef Eric Teo as he swaps the kitchen for the archery range and tries to learn a new discipline in seven days. The story mixes light entertainment with a clear training arc, from first-time technique and physical strain to a final 36-arrow test at 15 metres with a 300-point goal.

Jinee contributed as researcher and writer.
heading: Researcher | Writer

videos.title: 7 Days, I Can Do It | Celebrity Chef Eric Teo Learns Archery in 7 Days
videos.description: Chef Eric Teo begins as a confident beginner, but the first episode quickly turns archery into a fish-out-of-water training story built on repetition, fatigue, and a surprisingly steep learning curve.

videos.title: 7 Days, I Can Do It | 36 Arrows, 300 Points — Can Chef Eric Teo Do It?
videos.description: The finale narrows the whole challenge to one clean test: 36 arrows, 15 metres, and a 300-point target that turns a light entertainment format into a suspenseful payoff.

portfolioCard.cardTitle: 8World | 七天我可以 7 Days, I Can Do It

title: 8world | Frontline
description: 8world Frontline stories on fertility, caregiving, and the family choices Singaporeans make under pressure.
longDescription: This 8world Frontline pairing looks at two family decisions under pressure in Singapore: whether to have children in an era of record-low fertility, and who pauses life to care for ageing parents or sick family members. One episode weighs the emotional and financial cost of parenthood; the other follows male caregivers navigating exhaustion, stigma, and responsibility.
Jinee contributed as field producer on both episodes.
heading: Field Producer

videos.title: Frontline | Fertility rate falls to 0.87 Are Singaporeans going extinct?!
videos.description: A reported look at why Singaporeans hesitate to start families, following the financial, emotional, and social pressures behind the country's record-low fertility rate.

videos.title: Frontline | Who Says Caring for Parents Is Only for Women?
description: This companion story follows male caregivers balancing work, fatigue, and filial duty as they care for ageing parents and sick relatives.
It broadens the series from fertility decisions to the unequal care burdens shaping family life in Singapore.

title: CNA Insider | UNIQLO
description: CNA Insider feature on inclusive retail design and UNIQLO's assisted shopping pilot in Singapore.
longDescription:
This CNA Insider feature tests how inclusive retail design works in practice, following shoppers who are blind, use wheelchairs, or live with autism and sensory sensitivities as they navigate a UNIQLO store. The story focuses on real usability, from quiet-hour appointments and assisted shopping to wider walkways and an accessible fitting room.

Jinee co-produced and shot the piece in Singapore.
heading: Co-Producer | Videographer

videos.title: We Try UNIQLO’s Private Shopping Services, For Customers With Special Needs
videos.description: Three shoppers with different access needs put UNIQLO's assisted-shopping pilot to the test, turning a retail feature into a practical story about usability, dignity, and what inclusive design feels like in real life.

title: CNA Insider | Fibromyalgia
description: CNA Insider documentary on fibromyalgia and the strain of living with chronic pain that often goes unseen.
longDescription:
This documentary follows people living with fibromyalgia, a condition marked by widespread pain even when standard tests appear normal. The story looks at the medical uncertainty, social doubt, and emotional exhaustion that come when patients must keep explaining an illness others cannot easily see.

Jinee co-produced and shot the piece in Singapore.
heading: Co-Producer | Videographer

videos.title: Living With Chronic Pain That Even Doctors Don’t Believe - This Is Fibromyalgia
videos.description: Through first-person accounts from fibromyalgia patients, the documentary traces the pain of being disbelieved, misdiagnosed, and forced to explain an invisible illness that medicine still struggles to define.

portfolioCard.cardTitle: Living With Chronic Pain That Even Doctors Don’t Believe - This Is Fibromyalgia

title: Mark Your Calendar | 历历在目 | Infotainment
description: Infotainment series exploring how Singapore celebrates Halloween, Deepavali, Winter Solstice, and Christmas.
longDescription:
This four-episode infotainment series uses major festivals as a way into Singapore's multicultural calendar. The selected episodes follow hosts into Halloween parades and trick-or-treat parties, Deepavali traditions and festival markets, Winter Solstice food rituals, and Christmas activities from logcake making to church services.

Jinee produced and directed the series in Singapore.
heading: Producer | Director

videos.title: EP10 萬聖節Halloween | Host: 龐蕾馨(Kate Pang )、謝穎澤(Estovan)
videos.description: A festive culture episode that uses Halloween parades, trick-or-treat parties, and the folklore behind jack-o'-lanterns to turn a global holiday into an accessible Singapore-set story.

videos.title: EP11 屠妖節 Deepavali | Host: 王偉良、冼慧(Amelia)
videos.description: From oil lamps and henna to temple visits and the festival village, this episode turns Deepavali into a vivid introduction to ritual, symbolism, and community celebration in Singapore.

videos.title: EP12 冬至 Winter Solstice | Host: 王偉良、何怡萱
videos.description: Built around tangyuan, Chinese herbs, and communal dishes, the story reframes Winter Solstice as a warm explainer about reunion, food rituals, and the way tradition travels across generations.

videos.title: EP13 聖誕節 Christmas | Host: 王偉良、冼慧(Amelia)
videos.description: With letters to Santa, logcake making, and church services, the finale balances playful holiday imagery with the deeper roots that made Christmas a worldwide tradition.

portfolioCard.cardTitle: Mark Your Calendar | 历历在目 | Infotainment

title: Little Red Dot Detectives | Infotainment
description: Infotainment travel series uncovering local history and everyday culture in Little India and Ang Mo Kio.
longDescription:
This family-friendly infotainment series introduces neighbourhood history through on-location discovery. In the featured episodes, the hosts explore Little India through migration history, food, garland-making, and henna, then move to Ang Mo Kio and Bishan to uncover estate names, mosaic playgrounds, murals, and small trades that shaped daily life.

Jinee produced and directed the series.
heading: Producer | Director

videos.title: S1 EP6 Little India | Host: 葉慧馨+曾思涵
videos.description: A neighborhood adventure through Little India that layers migration history, street snacks, garland-making, and henna into a lively portrait of one of Singapore's most vibrant cultural districts.

videos.title: S2 EP5 Ang Mo Kio | Host: 葉慧馨+冼恩
videos.description: This episode uncovers how estate names, mosaic playgrounds, murals, and small trades carry local memory, turning Ang Mo Kio and Bishan into a playful lesson in neighborhood history.

title: I Eat Therefore I am | 我食。故我在 | Infotainment
description: Food and culture episode on Indian vegetarian cuisine and the wellness philosophy of Ayurveda.
longDescription:
This episode explores Indian vegetarian cuisine through the lens of Ayurveda, treating food as both daily ritual and a system of balance. The storytelling connects ingredients, cooking, and wellness traditions in a way that makes the cultural philosophy accessible to a general audience.

Jinee produced and directed the episode.
heading: Producer | Director

videos.title: I Eat Therefore I am | 我食。故我在 | E10
videos.description: A food-and-wellness story that connects Indian vegetarian cuisine with Ayurvedic philosophy, using cooking and ritual to open a broader conversation about balance, healing, and cultural identity.

portfolioCard.cardTitle: I Eat Therefore I am | 我食。故我在

title: The Guardians 守護者| Vietnam 越南 | Infotainment
description: Infotainment documentary on volunteer groups in Ho Chi Minh City caring for the poor and the unidentified dead.
longDescription:
This documentary follows volunteers in Ho Chi Minh City who live modestly so they can care for poorer families and reclaim dignity for the unidentified dead recovered from the Saigon River. The story balances compassion, ritual, and social reality to show how ordinary people take responsibility for lives and deaths most others overlook.

Jinee produced and directed the piece.
heading: Producer | Director

videos.title: The Guardians 守護者| Vietnam 越南 | Infotainment | E9
videos.description: Set in Ho Chi Minh City, the documentary follows volunteers who support poorer families and recover the unidentified dead from the river, revealing a quietly powerful story about dignity, grief, and responsibility.

portfolioCard.cardTitle: The Guardians 守護者 | Vietnam 越南 | Infotainment

title: CNA Insider | Gen Z Lion Dancers
description: Documentary featuring lion dancers and their cultural significance.
longDescription: A short documentary exploring the art and tradition of lion dancing in Singapore. The film delves into the history, techniques, and cultural importance of this vibrant performance art.
heading: Co-Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: Gen Z Lion Dancers Of TikTok Fame: Is Passion Enough?
videos.description: A character-led documentary about young lion dancers balancing viral attention, demanding physical training, and the question of whether cultural passion can sustain adult life.

portfolioCard.cardTitle: CNA Insider | Gen Z Lion Dancers

title: Into The Gym | Johnson Health Tech Web Series
description: Johnson Health Tech web series pairing Kunda with athletes and creators for fitness challenges and workouts.
longDescription:
A nine-episode branded web series that turns Johnson Health Tech products into repeatable entertainment formats, pairing host Kunda with athletes, entertainers, and creators for training sessions, sports challenges, and celebrity fitness routines. Across the season, each guest brings a distinct audience and skill set, helping the brand reach both hardcore fitness fans and casual lifestyle viewers.

Jinee served as executive producer.
heading: Executive Producer

videos.title: 坤達對決世界球后戴資穎，看小戴挑戰100秒20宮格羽球準度挑戰！【 EP1 】
videos.description: The season opener pairs host Kunda with badminton champion Tai Tzu-ying, turning a celebrity workout into a brisk challenge story built on precision, competitive tension, and world-class training habits.

videos.title: 坤達揪Joeman健身，意外發現防綠帽神器【EP2】
videos.description: A studio visit with Joeman mixes creator banter and fast-burn coaching, showing how the series can fold influencer culture and practical fitness tips into one brand-friendly format.

videos.title: 坤達揪 法國人酷KU健身，進階版炸裂胸肌訓練。KU：竟然有這種方法？！【EP3】feat.酷的夢
videos.description: This episode teams Kunda with French creator KU for an advanced chest workout, then widens into food and lifestyle beats that keep the branded fitness format playful rather than repetitive.

videos.title: 袁艾菲為金鐘獻上深V裸背，坤達以美背三式相助艾菲【EP4】
videos.description: A home-visit episode with Yuan Ai-fei blends cooking, comedy, and targeted back training, framing the workout around a real appearance goal instead of generic exercise advice.

videos.title: 每朝女神張景嵐性感報到！獨家小蠻腰健身菜單，坤達:「我們可以偷偷的⋯」【EP5】
videos.description: With Zhang Ching-lan, the series leans into playful chemistry, combat-style cardio, and a defined ab routine, weaving product features into the episode without breaking the entertainment flow.

videos.title: 全壘打大賽！坤達蔡哥拚盡尊嚴，努力揮擊。陳晨威：讓你們拿鋁棒【EP6】
videos.description: Shot at a pro ballpark, this baseball-themed episode scales the format up with stadium access, sports-star competition, and locker-room variety energy while keeping the workout challenge at its core.

videos.title: 雙生鬥士 Yin&Yei 籃壇帥度破表，籃球一哥 坤達表情逐漸母湯！【EP7】
videos.description: Twin basketball players Yin and Yei bring a strong guest hook to an episode that balances on-court games, core training, and music-driven class moments that make digital fitness feel social and fun.

videos.title: UFC八角鐵籠的終極格鬥賽？ 夢多直誇天才！坤達：我有看第一神拳？！【EP8】
videos.description: An octagon-style challenge with Dreamondo pushes the series into fight-sports spectacle, using humor and host vulnerability to make a punishing workout feel human, accessible, and highly watchable.

videos.title: 坤達使出回憶殺！Johnson@mirror眾星開箱體驗！【EP9】坤達一打十超精彩健身魔鏡開箱合集
videos.description: The season recap repackages standout guests, mirror functions, and challenge highlights into a campaign-friendly supercut that extends the series' value well beyond its weekly release.

title: CNA Insider | Lunch With Us
description: CNA Insider food series exploring affordable, character-rich meals across Singapore and Taipei.
longDescription:
This four-part food series uses affordable meals as a way into local culture, from Tekka's Indian-Pakistani hawker fare to Taiwanese bentos, budget fast-food counters, and a karaoke cab driver's comfort-food circuit. Each episode is built around a guide with a strong point of view, keeping the storytelling personal, useful, and location-specific.

Jinee produced, directed, and shot the series.
heading: Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: Budget 'Fast-Food' Hopping In Taiwan: From Vegetarian to Pork Cheap Eats | Taipei
videos.description: A budget food crawl through Banqiao turns Taiwanese fast food into a neighborhood story, with local guide Matt Chen connecting low prices, long-simmered craft, and everyday eating habits.

videos.title: S$6 Michelin Meals at Indian-Pakistani Hawker Stall in Tekka | Singapore
videos.description: Guided by a chef through Tekka Centre, this episode folds heritage, affordability, and regional nuance into one lunch stop, ending at a Michelin-recognised stall known for S$6 Indian-Pakistani meals.

videos.title: Taiwan-style Bento Meals With Old-School Touch & Retro Vibe | Taipei
videos.description: Writers lead this retro Taipei bento story through memory, decor, and food history, turning a simple lunch into a place-based portrait of old-school Taiwanese everyday culture.

videos.title: Taiwan's Karaoke Cabbie Takes Us To Comfort Food 'Club' | Taipei
videos.description: A karaoke-cab driver makes this Taipei lunch story character-first from the start, using personality and subculture to lead viewers into a long-running drivers' canteen and its comfort-food ritual.

title: Marigold | Commercial
description: Commercial for Marigold.
longDescription: A television commercial campaign for Marigold, one of Singapore's leading dairy and beverage brands.
heading: Producer | Director

videos.title: Marigold TVC Campaign
videos.description: A flavour-launch commercial built around taste, probiotics, and feel-good wellness, translating a simple FMCG brief into bright, benefit-led consumer messaging.

title: Ministry of Manpower | Corporate Video
description: Corporate video for Singapore's Ministry of Manpower.
longDescription: A corporate video produced for Singapore's Ministry of Manpower highlighting the annual Dormitory Awards. The piece showcases best practices in foreign-worker dormitory management and celebrates operators who provide safe, well-maintained living conditions.
heading: Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: Ministry of Manpower Singapore - Dormitory Awards 2017.
videos.description: Produced for MOM's Dormitory Awards, this institutional piece turns a recognition event into a clear stakeholder story about care standards, worker well-being, and the people shaping better living conditions.

title: Nestlé | Commercial
description: Commercial for Nestlé.
longDescription: A television commercial campaign for Nestlé, featuring their Nescafé product line.
heading: Producer | Director

videos.title: Nestlé TVC Campaign
videos.description: A premium coffee spot that sells indulgence through fuller aroma, velvety foam, and cafe-style convenience, giving a product launch the polish of a richer everyday ritual.

title: CNA Insider | SCDF 995 Calls
description: Two-part CNA Insider series embedded with SCDF emergency crews, from 995 calls to frontline ambulance response.
longDescription:
This two-part documentary goes inside Singapore's emergency medical system, following 995 call takers, dispatchers, paramedics, and ambulance crews under pressure. The reporting moves between operational detail and emotional reality, covering abusive callers, blocked ambulances, and the split-second decisions that shape patient outcomes.

Jinee co-produced, directed, and shot the series.
heading: Co-Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: SCDF Officers React To Abusive Calls, Emotional Cases And Ambulance-Blocking Drivers
videos.description: Told through EMS officers' reflections, this companion piece shows how abuse, blocked ambulances, and emotional cases complicate emergency work long after the sirens fade.

videos.title: On Call With Singapore's SCDF Emergency Medical Services: When Minutes Can Mean Life Or Death
videos.description: With embedded access to call-takers, dispatchers, paramedics, and hospital staff, the film turns emergency response into a systems story where every minute carries human consequence.

title: CNA Insider | Scam Series
description: Two-part CNA Insider scam series told through survivors of investment and romance fraud.
longDescription:
This two-part documentary series reconstructs how online scams gain trust before taking money, using first-person accounts from victims of investment and romance schemes. Each episode stays close to the subject's decision-making, showing the emotional manipulation, warning signs, and aftermath that make these cases resonate beyond the headline.

Jinee produced, directed, and shot the series.
heading: Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: I Fell For An Investment Scam: Here's How They Got Me
videos.description: A first-person scam story that follows one victim from online trust to devastating loss, making the mechanics of a pig-butchering scheme feel personal, legible, and urgently real.

videos.title: I Fell For A Love Scam: How They Made It Seem So Real
videos.description: Framed through a romance-led con, this episode shows how intimacy, secrecy, and future planning became the engine of financial fraud, giving scam psychology an unusually human face.

title: CNA Insider | MOM
description: CNA Insider profile of a robotics engineer building a career and community in Singapore.
longDescription:
This documentary profiles a Thai-born robotics engineer who built his career in Singapore and now uses that experience to mentor and give back. The story combines professional ambition with questions of belonging, contribution, and what makes a place feel worth staying in.

Jinee produced, directed, and shot the film.
heading: Producer | Director | Videographer

videos.title: I Build Robots For A Living. Here's Why I Chose To Work In Singapore & How I'm Giving Back
videos.description: This profile follows Thai robotics engineer Krittin Kawkeeree as he builds autonomous systems and mentors local talent, linking one career story to bigger questions of belonging, opportunity, and contribution in Singapore.

title: CNA Insider | TV Spin Offs
description: CNA Insider documentary about a Singapore father rebuilding life after 14 years as a stay-at-home caregiver.
longDescription:
This documentary follows a father who spent 14 years as the primary caregiver for his son and is now trying to rebuild an identity outside the home. The film looks at masculinity, sacrifice, and the emotional cost of putting one role on hold for so long.

Jinee produced, directed, shot, and edited the film.
heading: Producer | Director | Videographer | Video Editor

videos.title: I Spent 14 Years As A Stay-At-Home Dad For My Son. Here's Why It's Time To Reclaim My Life
videos.description: A candid portrait of a father rebuilding life after 14 years of caregiving, using one family's story to explore masculinity, sacrifice, isolation, and the slow work of reclaiming selfhood.
